detailed_description: Word to HTML converter transforms Microsoft Word documents (.docx) into clean HTML code. Preserves basic formatting like headings, bold, italic, and lists. Perfect for web publishing.
usage_steps: Open the Word to HTML tool page
Drag and drop a DOCX file or click to select
Preview the HTML or view the source code
Copy the HTML code or download as HTML file
usage_examples: Convert Word documents for web publishing
Create web pages from Word files
